snippet.title: You feel normal - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
You Feel Normal.
is a "psx" atmospheric horror indie game.

The game is published on Itch.io and soon on Steam.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2892270/you_feel_normal/?beta=0

Itch.io page: https://zivizr.itch.io/youfeelnormal

You find yourself stranded along a lonely, abandoned road, desperately seeking help. You stumble upon an old, farm-themed amusement park,
you will feel.
